---
name: issue-delivery
description: Deliver an approved GitHub issue through implementation, documentation, tests, and a review-ready pull request.
---

# Issue delivery skill

1. Verify the issue is triaged and approved with `ready-for-building`.
2. Read acceptance criteria, repository instructions, and all path-specific instructions.
3. State a short implementation plan in the pull request or agent log.
4. Implement the smallest complete change across every required layer.
5. Invoke the documentation and testing skills before opening the pull request.
6. Use `Closes #<issue>` and identify risk or review focus.
7. Do not add `ready-for-qa`; that label belongs to the post-review workflow.
